evals.prompt: I have an RTL repo at repos/coralnpu that uses bazel with Chisel and cocotb tests. Convert it into Harbor benchmark tasks. The repo has 305 test targets including unit tests, Verilator testbenches, and cocotb E2E simulations.
evals.expected_output: Complete Harbor task structure with Dockerfile (3-stage with warm cache + hardening), task.toml (24h agent timeout, 3h verifier timeout), instruction.md, test.sh verifier, solve.sh, and sync-skeleton.sh. Skeleton should strip Chisel implementation but keep test specs.

evals.prompt: I have a RISC-V core repo that uses cmake + verilator for testing. There are about 50 test targets: some run ISA compliance tests via verilator, others are C++ unit tests for individual pipeline stages. I want to create a Harbor task from it.
evals.expected_output: Harbor task adapted for cmake build system. Dockerfile installs cmake, verilator, riscv-gcc toolchain. Warm stage runs cmake build + ctest. Skeleton strips RTL sources but keeps testbench files and cmake configuration. Hardening scrubs cmake build directory artifacts.

evals.prompt: Create an E2E-only variant of an existing Harbor task. The full task has 305 targets but I want a variant that only scores the ~189 cocotb end-to-end simulation tests, excluding component-level unit tests.
evals.expected_output: New task variant directory with modified test.sh that queries only E2E targets, separate task.toml, instruction.md explaining the E2E-only scoring, and e2e_targets file captured during warm stage.
